stated: Require all government agencies and contractors and companies with more than 250 employees to sign up to the prompt payment code, making it enforceable.

source.quote: Tackle the late payments crisis by requiring all government agencies and contractors and companies with more than 250 employees to sign up to the prompt payment code, making it enforceable.

bearing_set.reason: Enforcing prompt payment directly protects the cash flow, income security, and viability of small businesses and the self-employed — people whose effective 'pay' depends on receiving money owed for work already done; serial late payment is a documented driver of SME insolvency and in-work financial distress.

Unpaid and late invoices are a leading cause of small-business failure and suppress investment; enforceable prompt payment rules would improve firm survival, business investment and economic dynamism — concrete indicators under prosperity and opportunity.

membership_note: The policy bears on O4 (security/quality of income for self-employed and small-business owners) and O13 (firm formation, survival and business investment). Effects on O14 (inequality between large and small firms) are real but flow through the same mechanisms and do not add a distinct non-negligible verdict beyond O4 and O13. No material fiscal, liberty, or other cross-outcome spillovers clear the non-negligible bar.
